description: This file defines the Error package in Perl, including classes Error and Error::Simple, error handling functions (try, catch, finally, etc.), error object methods, and error stack tracing. It implements an object-oriented approach to exception handling with syntactic sugar for try/catch blocks.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error objects with methods for object info, stack tracing, and throwing errors.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: A subclass of Error for simple textual errors with optional value.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides implementation for try/catch/finally exception handling syntax.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: Handles custom warning and die signal processing for error reporting.

methods.name: Error::import
methods.description: Imports export tags and error handling subs, manages warning/die hooks.

methods.name: Error::prior
methods.description: Returns last error created or associated with a package.

methods.name: Error::flush
methods.description: Clears last error or package-associated error.

methods.name: Error::stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the stack trace or error message with location info.

methods.name: Error::associate
methods.description: Associates an error object with another object for propagation.

methods.name: Error::new
methods.description: Creates a new error object with caller info and optional debug trace.

methods.name: Error::throw
methods.description: Throws the error, possibly rethrowing if called on an existing error.

methods.name: Error::with
methods.description: Syntactic sugar to create and return an error object.

methods.name: Error::record
methods.description: Syntactic sugar to create and return an error object.

methods.name: Error::try
methods.description: Executes a code block with exception handling clauses.

methods.name: Error::catch
methods.description: Adds a catch clause for specific exception classes.

methods.name: Error::finally
methods.description: Adds a finally clause to execute after try block.

methods.name: Error::except
methods.description: Defines custom error handlers based on exception class.

methods.name: Error::WarnDie::DEATH
methods.description: Custom die handler to format and throw errors.

methods.name: Error::WarnDie::TAXES
methods.description: Custom warn handler to output error warnings.

methods.name: Error::WarnDie::import
methods.description: Sets signal handlers for warn and die.
